status: v2 registered 2026-10-24 after G1 (train/dev only) and before any network training on the v2 targets or any test-cell scene; the v1 S1/S2 targets are superseded, v1 data and results are kept as evidence

baseline.planner: TimedSingleArmPlanner at a77abd5 (planning code 541fdbc, includes MOTION-294)
baseline.note: old zero/Home; conclusions are not extrapolated to upstream 0942d18

scope.S1: contact candidate ranking, dual and single arm (64 analytic contacts per round)
scope.S2: placement goal ranking for the selected root (dual: 8 of the 512 shortlist; single: 64 of the filtered pool)

cost.J_arc: sum over all consecutive frames of the untimed round of ||dq * w||, w = [2.6179939 (updown, 10 cm = 15 deg), 1 x 14], plus the box rotation soft cost BoxRotationCost.edge_cost (ActiveRotationCost for single arm) summed over the densified transport path
secondary: executed weighted arc and motion duration of the timed round (A/B only)
cost.diagnostic: Spearman(J_arc, T_motion) on the time-parameterized 8 lowest-J_arc S1 successes of 10 dev instances; boundary statement only

classes.wording: budget_exhausted is reported as 'not connected within budget', never as infeasible

scenes.cells: cell = (row, min(column, 4 - column)); rng 311 draws 3 test cells (one per column class, >=1 top-suction and >=1 side-suction row) and 2 dev cells (one top row, one side row)
scenes.assignment: test if any box lies in a test cell, else dev if any lies in a dev cell, else train; all offsets and seeds of a task stay in its split
scenes.docking_offset: (dx, dy) ~ U(-0.05, 0.05) m rounded to 0.1 mm; pick-side scene shifted as in MOTION-327; conveyor and placement targets fixed

variants.seen_test: 1 new offset per train/dev task, online only
variants.out_of_range: 1 offset with max |d| in (5, 8] cm per test task, report only

labels.S1: every contact forced alone; dual = one lazy batch with only that contact and the 2 s transport budget (exact simulator of a single-candidate batch, whose smaller budget is a prefix of the same search); single = contact order [i]
labels.S2: baseline-selected root + 1 random successful root; dual: the 8 baseline goals + 8 distance-quantile goals of the 512 shortlist; single: reached goal + 7 of the baseline 64 + 8 distance-quantile goals beyond them; each forced alone
labels.S2_instances: half of the train/dev instances (sha1(instance) even), all test instances
labels.suffix_memo: conveyor suffix memoised per instance by the transport-end configuration (exact replay)
labels.budget_success_rule: success under budget B <=> first_verified_solution_ms <= B; within +-15 % of B marked ambiguous
labels.noise_subset: about 10 % of train/dev instances re-labelled with seed offset k = 1 (all RRT seeds + k * 1000003)
labels.censoring_subset: up to 200 budget_exhausted S1 candidates re-run with budget_scale 3 (6 s)
labels.chunking: <= 25 min per GPU-lock acquisition; resumable per instance
labels.timed_diagnostic: dev instances: baseline pick + 3 J_arc quantiles (A3)

features.T0: contact joints (15), dq to Home, max |dq|/v_max, psi per arm (analytic swivel), branch signs sign(q2,q4,q6), singularity and limit margins, Home cost with in-set rank and z-score, box pose in the robot frame, side/top, single/dual
features.T1: 35 cm extraction endpoint (analytic, CPU), 8 nearest atlas goal distances (cKDTree built at init); atlases above 4096 rows subsampled (rng 311) for these distances (A8)
features.S2_T0: root and goal joints, weighted difference and norm, atlas metadata, goal-to-Home weighted distance, in-pool rank

latency_budget_ms.measurement: in-process perf_counter including Python overhead and the copy of candidates to CPU; numpy inference, no CUDA kernels, no RNG

model.architecture: per-candidate MLP, width {32, 64} x depth {1, 2}, SiLU; set information through in-set relative features

heads.S2: connect-and-complete-within-allocation logit + log J_S2 (transport + conveyor place + return home arc + rotation cost)

model.loss: BCE on y (ambiguous +-15 % band masked) + 0.5 Huber(delta 0.1) on log J of successes
model.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-3, weight decay {1e-4, 1e-3}, cosine schedule, <= 600 epochs, patience 80, CPU
model.selection: 5-fold CV grouped by cell on the train split; median out-of-fold regret; within 2 % prefer the smaller model; deploy a 5-seed ensemble

policy.dual: network top-m contacts as single-candidate lazy batches of 350 ms each (shared 2 s), then the unchanged baseline 8/16/32/64 schedule
policy.single: network top-m first, then the remaining candidates in baseline order
policy.S2: network goal order only inside the network's single-candidate attempts; baseline goals in fallback batches
policy.fallback: any failure after selection re-plans the round with the unchanged baseline; time counted
policy.score: S = P * J_hat + (1 - P) * max(J_hat over eligible); lambda = 0
policy.abstain: max P < 0.5 or any standardised T0 feature |z| > 6 -> baseline for that stage
policy.exclusion: S1 candidates without a 35 cm endpoint are excluded (necessary for extraction)

arms.A_prime: single-candidate batches in the baseline lazy order + same fallback (single arm: A' = A)

seeds.robustness: offset 1 for dual test, offsets 1, 2 for single test

metrics: extractions, searches, goals, selection attempts, fallbacks
T_timing, executed arc, T_motion (separate, never added to planning time)

gates.G1: per subset (side/top x single/dual x S1/S2): median [J_arc(baseline choice) - hindsight best] / J_arc >= 5 %, or (S1) median [A' selection time - best-first selection time] >= 150 ms; and median within-instance Spearman of J across seed offsets >= 0.5; failing subsets are not trained and are reported
gates.G2: out-of-fold: S1 vs A' dJ_arc <= -3 % or selection time <= -150 ms with first-attempt success >= A'; S2 vs baseline goals dJ_S2 <= -3 % without lower connection rate; regret >= 10 % better than the linear model, otherwise report only
gates.G3: dev online: B1 selections equal the simulator in >= 95 %, online/simulated planning-time median ratio in [0.8, 1.25]; B2 - B1 J_arc change has the predicted sign and no success regression

decision_rules_proposed.status: proposed defaults, to be confirmed by 李昊洋 in MOTION-337 before the test run
decision_rules_proposed.primary_analysis: held-out-cell test, seed offset 0, cluster bootstrap by task (10000) + Wilcoxon on per-task means
decision_rules_proposed.success: B2 >= A and at most one instance where A succeeds and B2 fails
decision_rules_proposed.cost: improved if median dJ_arc <= -5 % with p < 0.05 and CI upper < 0; non-inferior if <= +2 % with CI upper <= +4 %
decision_rules_proposed.time: improved if median dT_plan <= -15 %; non-inferior if <= +5 %; P95 <= 1.10 x A in both cases
decision_rules_proposed.attribution: B1 better than A' for S1 credit; B2 better than B1 for S2 credit

verdicts.effective: success + latency + one metric improved and the other non-inferior, not contradicted by the seen-cell test
verdicts.limited: only in pre-registered subsets, or attribution fails, or abstention > 50 % on the held-out test
verdicts.not_applicable: G1 fails, success fails, or no subset improves

hygiene: keep every run; infrastructure failures get one rerun with the original moved to invalidated/ with its reason
amendments only on dev evidence and before the test
pin commits and sha256 of runtime, registry and model
amendments_v1: A1 targets: y = success within the single-candidate allocation (dual: transport first_verified <= 350 ms; single arm keeps its 2 s searches); censored outcomes count as 'not within budget' for y (operational, not a feasibility claim); network outputs = success logit + log J; failure classes stay for reporting only
A2 score: J_fb = max predicted J over the eligible candidates of the set; lambda = 0
A3 timed diagnostic: the baseline pick + 3 J_arc-quantile S1 successes, on every dev instance (replaces top-8 on 10 instances)

A4 every successful run records its motion-phase endpoint configurations, so a velocity-limited straight-line time bound T_lb = sum_phase max_j |dq_j| / v_j is available for every candidate (diagnostic; J_arc stays primary unless the user decides otherwise at G1)
A5 baseline crash fix (crash path only): TaskCyclePlanner top-grasp failure partials without 'phases'/'payload' raised KeyError; L0 re-verified
A6 time comparisons use forced (warm) runs on both sides (dual: A' simulated from the forced runs; single: baseline order simulated), because each instance's first run carries per-scene warm-up
A7 S2 instances: half of train/dev by sha1 parity (unchanged); S1 for all; noise subset = sha1 % 10 == 0 (33 instances); censoring probe = up to 200 budget_exhausted S1 candidates at budget_scale 3

correction_v2.reason: user clarification 2026-10-24: 'global optimum' means the three coupled IKs of one transport - contact IK (with its 35 cm extraction end), carry IK (回中) and conveyor place IK (放箱) - chosen stage by stage without going back. v1 ranked only contacts and carry goals and kept the baseline place rule; G1 showed the first two choices near-optimal (median headroom 1-3 %), while place + return is 33-49 % of the round cost and the dual-top failures sit at the conveyor place RRT
correction_v2.decision: per round: contact c (64 analytic candidates), then carry g (carry atlas), then place p (enumerated place set), each chosen given the previous one; per-stage retry with the next candidate, never revisiting an earlier stage; final fallback = baseline round (time counted)

cost.primary: T_lb = sum over the motion segments Home->c, c->r(c), r(c)->g, g->p, p->Home of max_j |dq_j| / v_j (URDF velocity limits); evaluated on executed plans as T_lb_path = sum over planned frames of max_j |dq_j| / v_j

networks.N3: (g, p) -> P(place + return-home connect within budget), residual of realized place+return time over T_lb; V3(g) = min_p Q3, precomputed per mode
networks.N2: (r(c), g, task context) -> P(transport connects within budget), residual; Q2 = T_lb(r->g) + residual + V3(g)
networks.N1: (c, task context) -> P(extraction + approach), residual, and V2(c) (direct prediction; explicit min over N2 is an ablation)
networks.training: backward induction N3 -> N2 -> N1 on train-split labels; CV grouped by box cells as in v1; ensembles of 5
networks.recommendation: only candidates with P >= theta (0.5) by S = P*Q + (1-P)*Q_fallback; abstain otherwise (A9 kept)

data.P3: v1 labels (352 train/dev instances): contact/extraction/approach/transport outcomes; T_lb from recorded phase ends
data.D3: place stage: per mode (dual side/top, single left/right x side/top) 150 carry IKs from the P3 transport ends, contexts rotated over train/dev tasks and offsets; per carry the baseline place rule + 4 best analytic T_lb + 2 nearest to the baseline placement + 2 random enumerated place IKs, each through the real conveyor suffix; 20 pairs per mode re-run under 3 contexts (independence check)

gates.G1p: place stage headroom per mode: median over carries of (realized place+return T of the baseline rule - best labelled feasible) / baseline >= 5 %; plus the full-triple T_lb headroom from P3 + D3
gates.G2p: offline on dev: network stage choices vs baseline and vs B0 on T_lb, first-try success and estimated planning time
gates.G3p: dev online: selections equal the offline prediction, fallbacks equal the baseline, frames reproducible

arms.B0: T_lb-only analytic stage choices (no feasibility prediction), same retries and fallback

metrics: first-try success of the selected triple
success with retries/fallback and failure classes
planning wall time incl. features, inference and verification

decision_rules_proposed.status: proposed, to be confirmed by 李昊洋 in MOTION-337 before the test run
decision_rules_proposed.success: B >= A and at most one instance where A succeeds and B fails
decision_rules_proposed.cost: improved if median paired dT_lb_path <= -5 % (cluster bootstrap CI upper < 0); non-inferior if <= +2 %
decision_rules_proposed.time: non-inferior if median dT_plan <= +10 %; improved if <= -15 %
decision_rules_proposed.attribution: B better than B0 on the claimed metric for network credit

verdicts.effective: success + latency + cost improved (time non-inferior) + attribution, on held-out cells
verdicts.limited: only in some modes, or attribution fails, or abstention > 50 %
verdicts.not_applicable: G1p fails in all modes, or no mode improves

amendments_336: A8 (2026-10-23, before any training on train-split labels) T1 nearest-goal distance features use a fixed rng-311 subsample of 4096 rows for atlases larger than that (top: 44032 rows); 15-D k-d queries over the full top atlas took 11-17 ms. Planning atlases are unchanged

A9 (2026-10-23, same) the network recommends only candidates with P >= theta (0.5), ranked by S over those; the remaining candidates keep the baseline order; no candidate reaching theta = abstain. Offline ranking quality in CV is measured with theta = 0, the dev policy with theta = 0.5
amendments_v2: A10 (2026-10-24, from train-split diagnostics, before any v2 online run) the downstream value V3(g) used by the carry and contact stages is the analytic T_lb table (min over the place set of T_lb(g,p) + T_lb(p,Home)) in every arm; N3 trained on 150 realized carry IKs per mode predicts 1.8-2.9x the analytic value over the full carry atlas (D3 carries: ~1.2x), i.e. it extrapolates. N3 ranks the places of the realized carry, where its inputs are in distribution

A11 (same) out-of-distribution rule per candidate: a candidate with any feature beyond 6 training standard deviations gets P := 0 (never recommended) instead of the whole stage abstaining; candidate sets now mix generators (stored places, baseline IK). Cross-validation scores are computed over the rows the runtime would use; the excluded share is reported (ood_share)
A12 (same) model selection for N1/N2/N3 by the out-of-fold training loss (BCE + 0.5 Huber(0.1) on the log correction), Occam tie-break within 2 %; N1 now has a regression target

A13 (same) N1's regression head predicts log V2(c), distilled from the explicit V2 = min over the baseline goal pool (512 nearest carry rows of the predicted extraction end) of T_lb(r,g) + (1 - P2) C_fail + V3(g); the extraction/approach time correction is not modelled (T_lb). Arm Bx uses the explicit V2 (ablation). Arm B's contact value in the test is fixed by the dev online run before any test instance runs: the variant (distilled = B, explicit = Bx) with the lower median paired dT_lb_path against A over all dev instances; within 0.5 percentage points the one with the lower per-round selection latency p95

A14 (MOTION-337 planner, same) attempts per stage: contact = the Q1-best as a singleton lazy batch with 350 ms of the shared 2 s transport budget (dual) or first in the order (single), then the baseline schedule/order; carry = the Q2-best goal alone, or the unchanged baseline goal rule when the baseline's own best goal ranks first or no goal reaches theta; place = up to 2 single-goal attempts of the Q3-best stored place IKs (re-solved for the run's target), the baseline rule's nearest place IK being one ranked option, then the unchanged baseline place rule. A failed round is re-planned by arm A, both counted. Online A/B order alternates per instance; every chunk starts with one unrecorded warm-up round per arm

A15 (2026-10-24, after the dev online run ab-dev-20261024, before any test instance) (1) A13 decided: over the 93 dev instances the median paired dT_lb_path against A is -4.3 % with N1's distilled V2 and -7.0 % with the explicit V2, so arm B in the test uses the explicit V2 (planner contact_value = explicit). (2) Time metric made explicit: T_plan = the planner's total_ms (selection, searches, verification and any fallback round); the trajectory time-parameterization that follows (trajectory_timing_ms) and the wall time of both are reported next to it, because on dev the time-parameterization varied by arm. (3) Exceptions are split by message: scene (no contact IK, excluded when the baseline hits it too), CUDA out of memory, time-parameterization collision gate; all count as failures of the arm

A16 (2026-10-24, after the dev re-run ab-dev-20261024-n1fix, before any test instance) (1) Data fix: the P3 records store the contact-pose quaternions rounded to 1e-6, which made the offline analytic 35 cm endpoints fail in 153 of 337 records (e.g. L19-R21: 0 vs 62 eligible contacts at run time); record_context renormalizes them. N1 was retrained, with the regression target centred as log(V2 / 20 s) (CV log error 1.2 -> 0.14); the pre-fix model and reports are kept in train-v2-20261024/pre-n1fix. (2) Arms B (distilled V2) and Bx (explicit V2) were re-run on dev with the new N1; A and B0 do not use N1 and are reused (ab_merge). Distilled -4.7 %, explicit -7.1 % median dT_lb_path against A: the A13 decision stands, arm B in the test uses the explicit V2. (3) The ensemble inference evaluates all members' first layers in one matrix product (outputs bit-identical); the explicit V2's selection latency p95 on dev was 45 ms, above the 15 ms budget, and is reported as measured
